instruction: Via the terminal, change all .doc files found on the Desktop into RTF files at once.

command: cd /home/user/Desktop && tar -zcf rtf.tar.gz *.rtf 2>/dev/null || echo 'no rtf files'
output=$(cat ~/.bash_history | grep -E "(soffice|libreoffice).+--convert-to\s+rtf.+\*\.doc"); if [ -z "$output" ]; then echo "failed to complete this task"; else echo "catch the desired command"; fi
